description: Platform's own Renovate config: the shared preset plus the rules for the canons that live only here.

packageRules.description: The backend canon: Renovate proposes catalog versions in Platform only. The convention plugins read these versions from the generated PlatformVersions, so the catalog entry is the only edit (docs/versions.md).
The frontend canon: versions.json and the workspace manifests move in one pull request, or self-canon.test.mjs fails.
Major updates of the frontend canon stay separate, but each still updates versions.json and the manifests together.

customManagers.description: The frontend canon: every exact version in versions.json, from npm.
The digest-pinned Snyk image; deploy.yml and container-scan.yml move in one pull request (templates/tests/snyk-image-pin.test.sh).
